title: Board saturated-estate -> SEED yield branch has no test at any level (unit or golden)
evidence: core/growth.odin:739: `if board != nil && !growth_board_cluster_has_room(board, t, &gview, u32(i), cat.balance.terminal_min_sep_tiles, cat.balance.growth_groups.radius_tiles, span) {` — growth_board_cluster_has_room appears only in growth.odin (definition + 2 call sites), never in any *_test.odin. The only two board growth tests: core/map_test.odin:198 `terminals := dublin_growth_run(t, cat, &board, 0, {})` and :243 `terminals := dublin_growth_run(t, cat, &board, 1000, seeds[:])` over `// 480 ticks = 6 spawn windows (80 = the balance pace knob)` — both assert on-pool/in-radius only, on a fixture whose rings never exhaust. The lone dublin golden grows ~18 terminals on the 720-tile pool, so ring exhaustion never occurs there either.
detail: New state transition (estate loses eligibility when its street ring is legally full, yielding to the SEED family) is documented as the anti-stall guarantee but no test drives has_room=false and the golden tier's single dublin run never saturates a ring; a regression stalls growth silently.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test on a minimal board (one-tile ring per anchor) that fills the ring, then asserts the estate is skipped and a SEED-class spawn occurs instead of a stalled window.
